registration.title: Boosted trees correcting production's predictions
registration.what: Two boosted-tree regressions predict the error in production's expected margin and goal total from pre-match figures, and their corrections are added before the usual probability step.
registration.why: Production ignores shot counts where there is no xG, and its small calibration errors move over time.
registration.how: Forty-four features, each from earlier matches only: recent form against the model, shots and xG over the last ten matches, schedule, division changes, managers, injuries. Retrained every half-season on every scored match before it.
registration.hypothesis: A learned correction finds what the formulas miss.

expected.evidence: The final period had been looked at by earlier diagnostics, so this is strong historical evidence and not a blind test.

registration.success_criteria: The research round's bar (experiments/research_frame/REGISTER.md): better by 0.002 on the final period, the 99.6% interval excluding zero, Brier agreeing, better in 2024/25 and 2025/26, no goal market worse by 0.0005, and 60% of competitions no worse.

events.label: Final period
events.meaningful: Yes on this evidence: it meets every condition of the bar, in every season and in 48 of 62 competitions. About half the gain is recent shots.

events.note: It met the historical bar. The owner chose a prospective test before any change: protocol P13, blinded until 9,400 fixtures from 13 October 2026.

events.label: Final period, refitted on the released club rank
events.meaningful: Yes: still a real gain on top of the club-rank release (MC-0028), two thirds of its 0.0028 on the old model, in every season, every goal market, leagues and cups. Scored on every 90-minute score, ties after extra time counted as draws; on matches finished in 90 minutes only, 0.00199. Seen period: P17 is the unseen test.
